name: Drawably
summary: Hand-drawn React UI controls — fresh pen sketch every mount, boiling doodle strokes.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 20+ React exports (controls + composites + decorations) — not full inventory.
All demos share the single marketing page iframe (no per-component docs routes).
Vanilla (non-React) attach API also available via `drawably` package root — catalog focuses on drawably/react.
Replacement for SKIPPED bg-ibelick (no primary LICENSE) in Packet 050 queue.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Hand-drawn button with outline/solid/scribble variants and async states.

demo.peerNotes: import drawably/style.css; React >=18 peer optional for vanilla API

copyPrompt.text: Use drawably free MIT React component `DrawablyButton` (slug `button`) from https://www.drawably.dev. Install with `npm i drawably`, then `import { DrawablyButton } from "drawably/react"` and `import "drawably/style.css"`. Optional pen font: `import "drawably/font.css"`. Zero runtime deps beyond optional React peer. Hand-drawn SVG sketches with boil animation. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielwh2/drawably/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Daniel Belyi; also https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/drawably@0.4.2/LICENSE). Pricing free.
